irds:Benchmark.desc: an evaluable task: tables + citation + metrics

irds:DocPairTable.desc: A Table representing paired documents for a query (e.g. positive/negative pairs for training). Each row has query_id, doc_id_a, and doc_id_b fields.

irds:DocTable.desc: A Table representing a collection of documents (a corpus). Each row has a doc_id field.

irds:QrelTable.desc: A Table representing a collection of relevance assessments (qrels). Each row has query_id, doc_id, and relevnace fields.

irds:QueryTable.desc: A Table representing a collection of queries (topis). Each row has a query_id field.

irds:Resource.desc: bytes (a file, or a directory tree), and where to get them

irds:RunTable.desc: A Table representing a collection of retrieved and scored documents for a set of queries (a run). Each row has query_id, doc_id, and score fields.

irds:Suite.desc: a named set of related benchmarks (e.g. BEIR)

irds:Table.desc: a structured set of records (docs/queries/qrels/...); the shared parent of the per-entity table types below

irds:derived_from.desc: what a node is built from: bytes it is parsed from, another table it is filtered from, or a node its filter took ids from

irds:member.desc: suite -> a benchmark or nested suite it contains
